title: R13: orchestrator/promotion.py — shadow-first promotion framework: feature registry, evidence collection and evidence-based recommendation off/shadow/active (brief P15)
spec:
Why: several features have off/shadow/active modes ([jev.routing].mode, [scheduler].mode, upcoming jev scheduling, allocation, strategy, speculation) but promotion is a human judgement with no standard criteria; the brief (P15) requires explicit evaluation criteria and a rule that insufficient evidence means stay shadow.
What: new pure module orchestrator/promotion.py.
- FEATURES: ordered dict of feature -> {"table": pool.toml table path, "key": "mode", "modes": ("off","shadow","active"), "default": ..., "evidence": provider name}: jev_routing ([jev.routing] default shadow), scheduler ([scheduler] default shadow), jev_sched ([scheduler] key jev_mode default shadow), allocation ([allocation] default shadow), strategy ([strategy] default shadow), speculation ([speculation] default off).
- current_mode(feature, cfg) reads the pool config dict with the default; unknown values report the default and flag "invalid_config".
- CRITERIA defaults: min_samples 20; non-inferiority tolerances: first_pass_delta >= -0.02, fix_rounds_delta <= +0.05, gate_success_delta >= -0.02, review_findings_delta >= -0.10 (relative), security_ok must be True; improvement required in at least one of accepted_cost_delta < 0, accepted_tokens_delta < 0, latency_delta < 0. cfg overrides under [promotion].
- evaluate(feature, evidence, cfg=None) -> {"feature", "mode", "n", "recommendation": stay|promote|demote, "reasons": [..], "criteria": dict used}. n < min_samples -> stay ("insufficient_evidence"); any quality tolerance violated while active -> demote, while shadow -> stay ("quality_regression:<metric>"); Jev disagreement rate or raw token reduction alone never promotes (reasons state which criteria were missing). Promotion never changes config: it only recommends.
- collect(feature, root=STATE) -> evidence dict from existing telemetry, best effort: jev_routing from runs rows role jev_route (n, agreement rate) joined to task outcomes (first-pass via pipeline.lineage_fix_rounds, merged); scheduler from runs/sched/waves.jsonl (n, applied count) and stale rows; other features return {"n": 0} until their telemetry exists. Missing files -> n 0.
- report(cfg=None, root=STATE) -> list of evaluate results for every feature; format_report(rows) -> text lines.
acceptance: tests/test_promotion.py::test_insufficient_evidence_stays_shadow — n below min_samples yields recommendation stay with reason insufficient_evidence even when every delta improves
tests/test_promotion.py::test_token_reduction_alone_does_not_promote — n 50, accepted_tokens_delta -0.3 but first_pass_delta -0.1 yields stay with reason quality_regression:first_pass
tests/test_promotion.py::test_non_inferior_quality_with_cost_improvement_promotes — n 50, all quality deltas within tolerance, accepted_cost_delta -0.15 yields promote
tests/test_promotion.py::test_active_feature_with_regression_demotes — mode active and gate_success_delta -0.1 yields demote

tests/test_promotion.py::test_registry_defaults_and_invalid_config — current_mode returns defaults for every feature on an empty config, speculation default off, and an invalid mode string flags invalid_config; collect on an empty root returns n 0 for every feature

constraints.interface_contract: FEATURES registry with table/key/default per feature; current_mode(feature, cfg); evaluate(feature, evidence, cfg=None) -> {feature, mode, n, recommendation stay|promote|demote, reasons, criteria}; evidence keys: n, accepted_cost_delta, accepted_tokens_delta, first_pass_delta, fix_rounds_delta, gate_success_delta, review_findings_delta, security_ok, latency_delta, jev_disagreement_rate; collect(feature, root) -> evidence; report(cfg, root); never writes config
